FINAL QA — REMOVE RORK COMPLETELY AND VERIFY IVX INDEPENDENCE

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Complete the final QA required to remove Rork from the IVX development, build, deployment, runtime, AI, and autonomous-workflow chain.

TARGET

RORK ACTIVE DEPENDENCY = 0%

IVX must operate using:

- IVX-owned GitHub repository
- IVX-owned dependencies
- IVX-controlled AI credentials
- IVX-controlled GitHub Actions
- IVX-controlled Render services
- IVX-controlled Supabase project
- IVX-controlled owner authentication
- IVX autonomous developer
- IVX proof ledger
- IVX rollback process

Do not delete working production components before their IVX replacement is verified.

Do not mark PASS based only on text search.

Complete:

SCAN
→ CLASSIFY
→ REPLACE
→ TEST
→ COMMIT
→ PUSH
→ CI
→ DEPLOY
→ LIVE QA
→ CLEAN-ROOM PROOF
→ REMOVE RORK
→ FINAL EVIDENCE

==================================================
1. FREEZE THE CURRENT VERIFIED RELEASE
==================================================

Record before making changes:

- Repository: ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- Branch: main
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- GitHub Actions run ID
- API Render service ID
- API deployment ID
- Worker Render service ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Website deployment ID
- API live SHA
- Worker live SHA
- /version SHA
- Current rollback SHA
- Database migration version
- UTC timestamp

Verify before cleanup:

- https://ivxholding.com → HTTP 200
- /robots.txt → HTTP 200
- /sitemap.xml → HTTP 200
- https://api.ivxholding.com/health → HTTP 200
- https://api.ivxholding.com/version → HTTP 200
- Public chat → HTTP 200
- Worker unauthenticated route → HTTP 401
- GitHub HEAD = API SHA = Worker SHA = /version SHA

Do not proceed if the baseline is unstable.

==================================================
2. COMPLETE REPOSITORY-WIDE RORK SCAN
==================================================

Search every tracked source, config, build, test, deployment, native, and documentation file for:

rork
rork.com
r2-pub.rork.com
rork.json
@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk
EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_
RORK_API_KEY
RORK_TOKEN
RORK_SECRET
RORK_PROJECT_ID
RORK_BASE_URL
RORK_AUTH
RORK_FUNCTIONS
RORK_TOOLKIT
withRorkMetro
rorkIndependence
IVX_ALLOW_RORK_CUTOVER

Scan:

- backend/
- expo/
- android-ivx-holdings/
- ios-ivx-*/
- .github/workflows/
- deploy/
- scripts/
- package manifests
- lockfiles
- Dockerfiles
- Gradle files
- Podfiles
- Expo config
- EAS config
- Render config
- Supabase functions
- tests
- docs used by automation

For every match return:

- File
- Line
- Exact reference
- Active production dependency
- Active build dependency
- Active development dependency
- Defensive blocklist
- Migration tooling
- Historical documentation
- False positive
- Removal required
- Replacement
- Verification method

No item may remain UNKNOWN without explanation.

==================================================
3. VERIFY ZERO ACTIVE RORK PACKAGES AND SDKS
==================================================

Audit:

- package.json
- bun.lock
- package-lock.json
- pnpm-lock.yaml
- yarn.lock
- Podfile.lock
- Gradle dependencies
- Swift packages
- Git dependencies
- private registries
- postinstall scripts
- Expo config plugins

Required result:

- Active Rork packages: 0
- Active Rork SDKs: 0
- Rork private registries: 0
- Rork binary downloads: 0
- Rork postinstall calls: 0
- Rork Git dependencies: 0

Regenerate lockfiles after removal.

Return dependency evidence.

==================================================
4. REMOVE ORPHANED RORK ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES
==================================================

After proving reader count = 0, remove:

- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_API_BASE_URL
- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_APP_KEY
- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_AUTH_URL
- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_FUNCTIONS_URL
- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_TOOLKIT_SECRET_KEY
- EXPO_PUBLIC_TOOLKIT_URL
- Any other RORK_* variable

Audit across:

- Render API
- Render worker
- Render environment groups
- Expo/EAS
- GitHub Actions secrets
- Supabase functions
- local templates
- deployment scripts

For every variable return:

- Variable name
- Service/environment
- Reader count
- Before status
- Removal status
- Restart required
- Verification result

Never expose values.

If account-level deletion requires owner action, return exact manual steps.

==================================================
5. VERIFY AI INDEPENDENCE
==================================================

Map every AI route:

- IVX IA chat
- Public chat
- Senior developer worker
- Autonomous planning
- Document analysis
- Image analysis
- Video analysis
- Marketing AI
- Investor assistant
- Reports

For each return:

- Source file
- Provider
- Base URL
- Environment variable
- Direct call or proxy
- Rork dependency
- Runtime verification

Required result:

- Rork AI proxy: 0
- Rork AI SDK: 0
- AI provider credentials owned by IVX
- AI calls succeed directly through IVX backend/worker
- No AI key exposed in frontend/mobile

==================================================
6. VERIFY GITHUB AND CI INDEPENDENCE
==================================================

Audit:

- Repository owner
- Repository name
- Default branch
- GitHub Apps
- Deploy keys
- Webhooks
- Collaborators
- Actions
- Imported workflows
- Reusable actions
- CI secrets
- Branch protections

Required result:

- Repository: ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- No Rork GitHub App required
- No Rork deploy key required
- No Rork webhook required
- No Rork-owned GitHub Action
- No Rork sync layer required for normal development
- GitHub Actions runs directly on push to main

Required CI jobs:

- Backend tests
- Android release consistency
- Type checks
- Integration tests
- Security scan
- Secret scan
- Dependency audit
- Rork-independence guard
- Backend build
- Worker build
- Website build
- APK validation

All required jobs must be green.

==================================================
7. REPLACE RORK SYNC AND BUILD TOOLING
==================================================

Audit:

- expo/sync-github.mjs
- rork.json
- runChecks
- Rork-specific repository sync
- Rork-only build commands
- sandbox-only scripts

Create IVX-owned replacements:

- Standard Git remote
- GitHub Actions
- Standard commit/push commands
- Standard package scripts
- Render auto-deploy
- IVX worker deployment orchestration

The normal workflow must be:

LOCAL OR IVX WORKER
→ GIT COMMIT
→ GITHUB PUSH
→ GITHUB ACTIONS
→ RENDER
→ HEALTH CHECK

No Rork sync layer in the required chain.

==================================================
8. REMOVE RORK.JSON SAFELY
==================================================

Do not delete `rork.json` until all equivalent checks exist outside it.

First map every function currently provided by `rork.json`.

For every function return:

- Command
- Purpose
- IVX replacement script
- GitHub Actions step
- Test result

Then:

1. Remove all runtime/build references to rork.json.
2. Remove rork.json.
3. Run complete CI.
4. Build backend.
5. Build worker.
6. Build website.
7. Validate Expo.
8. Validate Android release.
9. Validate iOS configuration.
10. Deploy and verify.

Required result:

rork.json present: NO

==================================================
9. VERIFY RENDER INDEPENDENCE
==================================================

Audit all Render services:

- API
- Worker
- Static sites
- Cron jobs
- Redis
- Databases
- Environment groups

For every service return:

- Service name
- Service ID
- Workspace owner
- Repository
- Branch
- Root directory
- Build command
- Start command
- Dockerfile
- Health path
- Auto-deploy
- Rork dependency

Required result:

- All production services use ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- No Rork workspace required
- No Rork deploy hook
- No Rork build image
- No Rork proxy
- No Rork service account required

Legacy service names containing “rork” may remain temporarily only if the repo binding and runtime are independent, but rename them if safe.

==================================================
10. VERIFY SUPABASE INDEPENDENCE
==================================================

Audit:

- Organization ownership
- Project ownership
- Auth configuration
- Redirect URLs
- Database
- Storage
- Realtime
- Edge Functions
- Webhooks
- Vault
- RLS policies
- Service-role usage

Required result:

- No Rork redirect URL
- No Rork webhook
- No Rork Edge Function dependency
- No Rork-controlled service account
- Owner authentication works without Rork
- Worker authorization works without Rork chat

==================================================
11. VERIFY WEBSITE AND MOBILE ASSET INDEPENDENCE
==================================================

Search for all Rork-hosted assets:

- r2-pub.rork.com
- Rork CDN URLs
- Rork icons
- Rork logos
- Rork-hosted videos
- Rork-hosted configuration

Required result:

- All IVX production assets are local or on IVX-approved storage/CDN
- No Rork asset URL in web/mobile bundles
- No broken assets after migration

Verify:

- IVX logo
- business card image
- app icons
- splash screen
- reels media
- landing media
- PDFs
- uploaded media

==================================================
12. VERIFY RUNTIME NETWORK TRAFFIC
==================================================

Capture runtime traffic for:

- Website startup
- Public chat
- Owner login
- Member registration
- Owner dashboard
- Image upload
- Video upload
- Reels playback
- Worker heartbeat
- QA job
- Deployment job
- Android app startup
- iOS app startup where available

Create a hostname table:

- Hostname
- Provider
- Purpose
- Request count
- Approved
- Rork-owned

Required result:

Rork-owned hostnames contacted: 0

Also verify:

- Rork cookies: 0
- Rork WebSockets: 0
- Rork redirects: 0
- Rork telemetry: 0
- Rork authorization headers: 0
- Rork assets: 0

==================================================
13. COMPLETE AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT QA
==================================================

The final Rork-removal QA is incomplete until autonomous deployment works without Rork.

Required flow:

OWNER LOGIN IN IVX
→ OWNER APPROVES EXACT SHA
→ SHORT-LIVED SINGLE-USE AUTHORIZATION
→ IVX WORKER HMAC AUTH
→ GITHUB ACTIONS
→ BUILD
→ RENDER DEPLOY
→ HEALTH
→ VERSION
→ PROOF LEDGER
→ REPLAY REJECTION

Verify:

- Owner approval occurs inside IVX
- No token pasted into Rork chat
- No permanent Supabase user token stored in Render
- Worker authorization is single-use
- Worker executes exact approved SHA
- CI passes
- Deployment completes
- Proof ledger records the lifecycle
- Replay is rejected
- Worker restart does not repeat the job

Required evidence:

- Authorization ID
- Job ID
- Worker ID
- GitHub Actions run ID
- Approved SHA
- Executed SHA
- API deployment ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Proof ledger ID
- Replay result

==================================================

==================================================

- No Rork API key

Execute:
